changes.text: A newly added agent answers what you sent before its gateway came up: pairing and the gateway restart are separate steps, and the plugin started a first-seen agent's cursor at "now", so anything sent in between was skipped for good and the app sat on "Sent to an agent" (TestFlight feedback AMiI7ezKx6x1KcexlzOKYJc: an agent paired 22:36, gateway never restarted, "Did we stall?" never answered). A new agent now starts a day back (new_agent_floor); only unhandled user rows are fetched, so nothing already answered replays. Proof on the live case: cleared the agent's cursor, restarted, both waiting messages went in as one turn and an agent replied in 21s. Plugin only, no app build needed.

Links look like links: a card with url= gets an arrow on its button, opens the page in Safari and sends nothing to the chat, so the agent no longer answers a tap that already did its job (TestFlight feedback AHbFq_lhBMRFGDoCfVzMf4A: Install only posted "Install" and Yui replied with a second card). The test build card now points at yuigui.com/install.html, so Install opens Safari and installs from there. Channel guide: a link out is card ... url=. PresetFamiliesTests.testCardLink: Install opens Safari with no card event, Start still emits; testFlows passes

A test build's Install link parses whole: card url= keeps a 300+ character signed link with a fragment, an encoded manifest url, & and = and a JWT, quoted or not, whole or streamed one character at a time, for https and itms-services (TestFlight feedback AMbvlwiMPj49qT1jeKlZID4, build 61.1). The tap-instead-of-Safari bug itself is the url= link fix in dc11e1d, commit 66, after 61.1. CardLinkTests 2/2, YuiLines 11/11

Copy any part of a message: hold an agent bubble, Select text opens its words read-only, drag to select and Copy (or Copy all); a bubble at the bottom lifts so the menu never covers it (TestFlight feedback AG9JzU4LeWl-TFeKWftiFIE). Reply to a message is YUI-68. SelectTextTests 2/2 light + dark (no keyboard, whole text, Done closes), ComposerTests.testReactionLeavesTheComposerEmpty, YuiTests 44/44

The war room gets a timeline: Yui Lines timeline with done, now and next rows, drawn natively. Done rows oldest first with a check on the rail, a Now line across it, the running row lit up with a pulse (still under Reduce Motion), the queue in order; older done rows fold behind "N earlier"; a row with an https link opens Safari and sends nothing; a lone row is a one-row track. Swift parser: timeline group + rows, 372/372 vectors (22-timeline synced from yuigui). Flywheel PRESETS follows yl.mjs (13/13). TimelineTests 2/2 light + dark: fold opens in place, the link row opens Safari with no event

Reorder the war room queue by dragging, and the board follows with no agent turn. Timeline +reorder: Edit order gives each queued row a handle (drag, or VoiceOver Move up/down), done and running rows never move, Save sends one {order, board} event, Cancel restores; link rows stop opening Safari while editing. Plugin board.py: a timeline order with board=<this profile> from the paired owner goes straight to kanban priority for queued cards that are this profile's or unassigned (never another agent's, never running/blocked/done); the cards trade the priority slots they held, one transaction, a reprioritized event each (by yui-app); the person gets a one-line confirmation with no push, the agent a note on its next turn; anyone else gets "Only the owner can reorder". Swift 375/375 vectors, TimelineTests 4/4 on iPhone 18 Pro sim (real drag, light + dark), test_board.py 15/15 against a real kanban DB

Games in one Yui Line: game tictactoe, game snake, game memory, full screen by default. Tic-tac-toe against the agent: each tap relays {kind, move, x, o} (+ winner), the agent answers ~game o=... and the phone calls the winner with the winning line and Play again; snake (swipe or arrow pad, speed, size, best) and memory (pairs, agent-picked faces) run on the phone and send one result at game over. An unknown kind shows "This game isn't in this version of Yui". A patch aimed at a game an earlier reply drew lands on it. Reduce Motion fades, haptics per move, win and crash. Swift parser: game preset, 403/403 vectors (23-game synced from yuigui). Flywheel PRESETS follows yl.mjs. GameTests 2/2 on the sim, light + dark, with a demo stand-in agent answering moves

Yui MCP server: any MCP client puts a screen on the phone. Edge function yui-mcp (streamable HTTP, stateless, JSON-RPC by hand): yui_show parses Yui Lines with a synced copy of yl.mjs, refuses bad lines with the parser's message, writes one agent row and returns the screen id plus the tap ids; yui_answers returns taps and typed text once each (marked delivered and handled), waits up to 25 s, signs the person's photos for an hour; yui_say; yui_threads with unread counts. The full channel guide is the yui_guide prompt and yui://guide resource, a short form rides in the tool descriptions. Auth is a kind-mcp connector token from the app's pairing code (a Hermes token gets 403), own rate bucket mcp in yui_limits (60 burst, 30/min). mcp_test.py 34/34 live; mcp_claude_e2e.py: a real Claude Code (claude mcp add --transport http) asks on the simulator, MCPRoundTripTests taps Yes, Claude puts up a 20/10x8 timer, 9/9. OAuth is INT-19

Reply to a message: swipe a bubble left, or hold a bubble or a card and tap Reply (TestFlight feedback AG9JzU4LeWl-TFeKWftiFIE). The quote sits above the composer with an x; sent, the reply wears a chip (whose message, its first line) and tapping it scrolls back to the original, which glows. The hold menu is Reply, Copy, Select text on every bubble: the agent's keep the six reactions above it, your own get the menu alone, and a card takes reactions and Reply too (it quotes its question or title). The swipe is a UIKit pan that declines anything but a clear left drag on the bubble itself, so up and down still scroll, right still pages, the background beside a bubble and the screen's right edge still go to screen 2; a haptic tick at the threshold, Reduce Motion sets the quote with no slide. On the wire the app writes the line into an ordinary text row, like a reaction: body `[yui] reply to=<row id> from=agent quote="..."` then the words, meta.reply_to {msg, from, quote} next to any photos, so Hermes, OpenClaw and the webhook hosts all hand it to the agent unchanged; a slash command goes out bare. Channel guide v14 adds Replies. ReplyTests 3/3 on the iPhone 18 Pro sim (hold menu Reply, own bubble has no reactions, card quotes its question, gutter drag pages to screen 2, left swipe replies and stays on the chat, x clears, chip scrolls back, Reduce Motion), ReplyFormatTests 8/8, YuiTests 51/51, relay_test 51/51 live with a reply row, Pages/PageCount/SelectText/Timeline/Game/JumpToBottom green

The war room, built out: Needs you answers in one tap. Screen 2 now draws seven panels from presets the app already has (Needs you count + blocked cards, Running now per lane, the timeline, Builds with Install, Feedback and the card it became, the MVP bar, quick links), generated by the yui profile's yui_war_room.py. A Needs-you card with choices is choose@need-<task id> (a typed answer is form@need-<task id>): plugin needs.py takes the tap with no agent turn, comments the answer on the kanban card as chris (yui-app) and unblocks it (ready, or todo under an open parent), only for the paired owner and only yui's or unassigned cards; the person gets a one-line confirmation, the agent a note. test_needs.py 15/15 against real kanban DBs, test_board.py 15/15, WarRoomTests 3/3 on the iPhone 18 Pro sim with live board data (light + dark walk of every panel, one tap sends {id: need-t_..., choice})

Screens are dynamic, 2 to 12: the chat, then a page for each screen the agent puts something on (>5 alone makes chat and screen 5), and >N clear takes the page away, back to the chat if it was showing. The indicator above the composer is a small chat glyph and one dot per screen, the one on show filled and wider; with only the chat there is no indicator and no sideways swipe. >13, >0 and >02 stay in the chat. YuiLines.page(of:) takes 2 to 12 (YuiLines.maxPage), vectors 351/351. Reduce Motion re-scrolls a jump that stopped short on a page still being laid out. Channel guide: Screens 2 to 12. PageCountTests: chat only has no indicator, 2, 5 and 12 screens have 2, 5 and 12 tabs, no 13th, clear removes a page; PagesTests 3/3, YuiTests 41/41 (TestFlight feedback AHBOxACTsmO3vFCHkz29T9Q, build 57)

Screens are full screen: off the chat, the top bar (agents, settings) and the composer go away and the page gets the whole phone, with only the chat glyph and dots at the bottom; both come back on the chat, and the keyboard drops when you swipe to a screen. PageCountTests.testScreensAreFullScreen: no composer or nav bar on screen 2, both back on the chat; PageCountTests 6/6, PagesTests 3/3 (TestFlight feedback AK_HP72Gl1E_xK9soizV4Mc, build 57)

Hold to talk like WhatsApp: a live waveform and a clock while it listens, let go sends, slide left to the trash cancels (the trash arms at 110pt and says Let go to cancel); Reduce Motion gets one still level bar; a voice send leaves the keyboard down. The crash in this feedback came from build 57, before the fix in build 61: the pre-fix code traps on the simulator with speech + mic granted in the same frame as the phone (closure in PushToTalk.authorized, from TCC), the fixed code passes. PushToTalkTests 4/4 (waveform peaks, cancel discards), ComposerAttachTests 8/8 light + dark (real hold, slide and let-go through -yuiPTTFake), ComposerTests 4/4, YuiTests 45/45 (YUI-hotfix)

Test builds by link: scripts/devbuild.sh archives a clean worktree of origin/main as an ad hoc build (<commit count>.<n>, production APNs), hosts the .ipa and its itms-services manifest in the private yui-builds bucket behind 7-day signed links, and sends a card with an Install button into the Yui thread; no TestFlight, no upload limit, installs only on registered iPhones. card url= opens an https or itms-services link as well as emitting {cta}. media_sweep removes builds older than 8 days. README Test builds

Invites: yui_invites in PROOF (server only, RLS, no grants; the waitlist comes over as requests), supabase/scripts/invite.py lists, adds, approves and declines, and approve makes a one-time code (stored hashed) and adds the person to the external TestFlight group Invited through App Store Connect, so Apple sends the email and Yui sends none; the first Sign in with Apple claims the invite by the verified Apple ID email, or by the code from yuigui.com/i/<code> (a universal link, or yui://invite/<code>) or typed under Invite code on the sign-in screen; a signed-in person opening a link claims it at once, a bad code says so; wrong codes are rate limited; deleting the account deletes its invite, declined ones go after 30 days; testflight_public.py fills Invited too. invites_test 54/54, invite_claim_e2e 2/2

Tall screenshots stay inside their gallery: TallGalleryTests sends four phone screenshots (about 1:2.2) with a question card under them, every layout with and without +pick, and checks no photo runs under the card and no two overlap; Chris's 'still overlap' from build 33 is gone on build 57

Hold to talk no longer crashes: the speech permission answer, the mic tap and the recognizer's results come back on system threads, and the closures that took them were written inside the main-actor PushToTalk, so Swift 6 trapped the moment one ran (TestFlight crash ANv4a2bHdXMMaEjjhTva5ZA, build 57, _dispatch_assert_queue_fail in PushToTalk.authorized). They are now built in nonisolated code and hop to the main actor. A mic with no usable input (a call, a route change) shows can't listen instead of crashing in installTap. PushToTalkTests: start() with speech + mic granted trapped before, passes now; the tap and results called from a background thread reach the main actor. YuiTests 43/43

Findings, then questions, in one full-screen flow: a plan shows pages to read before its questions, opens full screen, closes itself on Send, and leaves a record in the chat (title, pages, answers, reopens the flow) plus your answers as your own message; channel guide v9

Saved screens get a shelf: the agent's saves sit as chips at the top of its thread, a tap reopens one full screen with no turn, hold to remove; show busy day works in a later reply, forget takes it off, events from a screen that came back carry saved=; the shelf rebuilds from the thread and is kept on the phone; channel guide v10

The preset flywheel: with yui.flywheel on, the Hermes plugin notes every custom screen an agent sends by its shape only (type tree and key names, never a value) plus unknown preset words, in a local log; flywheel_report.py ranks shapes by days and uses and flags the ones past the bar (5 uses on 3 days); tests prove no text, number or URL reaches the log
Flywheel report --seen: the weekly job announces a shape once, not every Friday

Webhook bridge, Python and Node: any agent that answers an HTTP POST can talk in Yui. Pair with the app's code, point the bridge at your agent's URL; each turn arrives as one signed POST with the channel guide, the answer goes back exactly once (outbox on disk, meta.turn, delivered/handled acks, replay after a crash), a clean stop reads offline. Ten-line example agents answer with a choose screen. Live test on a throwaway account: 44/44

Three screens per agent: the chat, then screens 2 and 3 a swipe away, with Chat, 2, 3 tabs above the composer and a dot on a page with something on it; a reply that sends a line to a page brings it forward with a spring, or a cross-fade under Reduce Motion, and the chat keeps an On screen 2 pill that goes there; pages keep their content across replies, >2 clear empties one, the page is remembered per agent; YuiLines.page(of:), 349/349 vectors; the shelf and the jump-to-bottom arrow stay on the chat page; channel guide v11

OpenClaw channel plugin: an OpenClaw agent talks in Yui the way a Hermes agent does. openclaw plugins install, openclaw yui pair <code> --agent main, restart the gateway; each turn runs through OpenClaw's own inbound dispatch with the channel guide and a plain 'Yui Lines, not A2UI' note in the trusted system prompt, the reply lands exactly once (outbox on disk, meta.turn, delivered/handled acks, replay after a crash), a clean stop reads offline, cron and the message tool deliver as handoffs. New connector kind openclaw. Live test on a throwaway account with a real gateway in a throwaway OpenClaw home: 24/24

next.text: Add Yui to an OAuth-only MCP client by pasting one URL: the Claude and ChatGPT apps' custom connectors, MCP Inspector, Claude Code with no header. yui-mcp answers 401 with WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata and serves RFC 9728 protected resource metadata; new function yui-oauth is the authorization server (RFC 8414 + OIDC discovery, also served under yui-mcp for clients that treat the MCP URL as the issuer), dynamic client registration (RFC 7591; https, loopback http or an app scheme), /authorize with PKCE S256 required and resource checked, /token (authorization_code, single-use rotating refresh tokens; a replayed code or refresh token revokes what it gave), /revoke (RFC 7009). /authorize sends the browser to www.yuigui.com/connect/<id>; the person approves in the app (yui://connect/<id> or the universal link /a/<id> as a QR) or types an Add agent pairing code on the page. Approval mints a kind-mcp connector named after the client, serving a new agent or an MCP/unbound one it picks (never a Hermes agent); access tokens point at that row, so limits, the kill switch and removing the computer apply unchanged. Only hashes stored; tables server-only; retention clears requests, expired tokens and unused registrations daily. App: ConnectApprovalSheet (Talks as: new agent or an existing MCP one, Allow, Don't allow, Open thread). mcp_test.py 77/77 live (43 OAuth checks), agents_test 59/59, push_test 36/36; mcp_oauth_e2e.py: the MCP TypeScript SDK's own OAuth client registers, ConnectApprovalTests taps Allow on the simulator, the client asks, Yes comes back, a tabata timer lands, 8/8

Slash commands in the composer: type / and the agent's own commands appear, one line each, filtered as you type; a tap fills the composer (/new plus a space when it takes arguments) and Send passes it through bare. The list comes from the host: yui_agents.commands (migration 20260925020000, on yui_agent_list and the yui-agents list), written only through the new yui-connect action commands, which cleans every entry (name ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$, one-line description <= 100, args <= 60, <= 200 entries, 32 KB check). Plugin commands.py builds it from Hermes' COMMAND_REGISTRY, gateway-available only, then plugin commands, then skills by their real /key, leaving out phone-irrelevant ones (start, topic, sethome, platform, restart, update, debug, codex-runtime, footer, commands, yolo, yui); the gateway reports it on start, on a newly served agent and when the list changes (fingerprint checked each heartbeat), `yui pair` reports it too, `yui commands [--send]` prints it. Agents with no registry (MCP, OpenClaw, demo) show nothing. SuggestionPopover is generic so @mentions (YUI-44) reuse it; light + dark, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion. test_commands.py 11/11, agents_test 67/67 live (8 new), relay_test 51/51, YuiTests 58/58 (SlashCommandFormatTests 7/7), SlashCommandTests 2/2 on the iPhone 18 Pro sim signed in to the real Yui agent (/, filter, fill /new, send /status, the gateway answers; demo agent shows no popover), ComposerTests green

Yui screens draw inside Claude and other MCP App hosts: yui-mcp 0.2.0 serves ui://yui/screen (text/html;profile=mcp-app, the yuigui web renderer in one file, copied by scripts/sync_mcp_app.py with the view's event rules) and names it in yui_show's _meta.ui.resourceUri; yui_show also returns structuredContent {screen_id, agent, ids, lines}. New app-only tool yui_tap (visibility ["app"]) writes a tap in the embedded screen as the same event row a phone tap writes ([yui] line and meta {id, preset, value, echo} worked out on the server, via mcp-app), only for a component on that screen in a thread the connection serves, drops quiet events, and writes it handled when the view already handed the line to the model with ui/message. CSP: images from Yui storage and fal only, no connections. mcp_test.py 92/92 live (15 new MCP App checks); mcp_app_host_e2e.py 13/13: the MCP Apps reference host (ext-apps basic-host) draws the screen, Playwright taps inside it in dark and light, the host gets the [yui] line and the thread the event row; mcp_claude_e2e.py --oauth 15/15: a real Claude Code adds Yui with no header, claude mcp get then claude mcp login (a cold login falls back to the shared host root and 404s at /register), approved with the Add agent code on the connect page, asks on the simulator, MCPRoundTripTests taps Yes, a timer lands

@mention another of your agents: type @ anywhere in the composer and the person's other agents come up in the shared SuggestionPopover (face, name, @handle, presence), filtered as you type; a tap lands `@Name `, a "Goes to <agent>" line sits over the composer, the sent bubble says "To <agent>". The app writes one row in the thread it is in: body `[yui] mention to=<handle>` + the words, meta.mention {to, handle, name}. Migration 20260925030000_yui_mentions.sql routes it in the database: the row lands delivered+handled (the host agent is not asked); a copy goes to the mentioned agent's thread with the host thread's last six lines quoted (meta.mentioned {from, from_name, msg, by, depth}); every agent reply whose meta.turn names that copy is mirrored back as an agent row with meta.mention_reply {agent, name, handle, msg, to}, drawn in the other agent's own look with "Open its thread" (its screens stay in its thread); asleep, offline, not-connected or muted agents answer at once with a one-line status in their look, sorted under the mention. Agents may @ each other only inside a turn the person started: plugin mentions.py sends @handles from a reply as meta.mentions, the trigger honours them only when the turn names a person row and no mention copy (depth 1, no loops). The host agent's next turn starts with [yui] note: lines on what was asked and answered in its thread. Channel guide v15 adds Mentions. Popover now sizes to short lists (it stretched for two rows). mention_test.py 38/38 live, test_mentions.py 11/11, MentionFormatTests 9/9, YuiTests 67/67, relay_test 51/51, agents_test 67/67, mention_e2e.py 13/13 with two real Yui adapters on this Mac and MentionTests on the iPhone 18 Pro sim (light: @, filter, pick, send, answer back in Bravo's look, Cleo offline; dark: reopen, follow the link into Bravo's thread), ComposerTests/ReplyTests/SlashCommandTests green

One working row while the agent is on it: the three-dot bubble and the "Sent to X · 5s" line said the same thing twice, so they are now one row. The agent's face, three small dots and one line: "On its way · 3s" until the host picks the message up, then a working word and the time ("Pondering · 12s"). The word changes every 4 seconds from a short friendly list (Pondering, Figuring it out, Mulling it over, Tinkering, ...). The long-turn "Long jobs are fine" hint and the asleep/offline notes stay. Reduce Motion: still dots, words swap without animation. VoiceOver reads "<agent>: Pondering · 12s". Demo account: -yuiDemoReply now answers through the store, with -yuiDemoPickupAfter/-yuiDemoReplyAfter to stretch a turn. WorkingNoteTests (unit) 5/5, YuiTests 65/65 (PushToTalk skipped), UI WorkingNoteTests 2/2 on the iPhone 18 Pro sim (send, On its way, Pondering, the word rotates, the row goes when the answer lands, light and dark), ComposerTests 4/4, ReplyTests 3/3

Yui in ChatGPT: yui-mcp 0.3.0 speaks ChatGPT's Apps SDK dialect next to the MCP Apps standard. Every tool declares securitySchemes (oauth2, scope yui, top level and in _meta); yui_show adds openai/outputTemplate (same ui://yui/screen) and status lines ("Putting it on your phone", "On your phone"), the others their own; yui_tap is openai/visibility private + widgetAccessible; the screen resource (also in resources/list) carries openai/widgetCSP (the same image domains, no connections), widgetDescription and widgetPrefersBorder. The view (yuigui mcp-app) falls back to window.openai when the bridge never answers and follows the host theme's color scheme. mcp_test.py 105/105 live (13 new ChatGPT-shape checks: metadata, ChatGPT's client _meta, DCR with both ChatGPT callbacks as a confidential client, /authorize with resource). New mcp_chatgpt_e2e.py 32/32: OAuth the way ChatGPT does it (discovery in the MCP spec's order, client_secret_post, PKCE, resource, refresh), the model's list without yui_tap, the template via openai/outputTemplate, then an Apps-SDK-shaped host frames it under a CSP from openai/widgetCSP and taps it over the MCP Apps bridge (dark) and window.openai only (light). mcp_app_host_e2e.py 13/13 unchanged
